ast_claims.src_name: What prefabs do **not** touch
ast_claims.quote: - `backlogCacheCap` (L3 backlog cache). Both the full and lite assemblies ship it at `1000` (enabled); set it to `0` in `regions/default.yml` to disable L3. Runtime prefabs do not change it on either side.

ast_claims.src_name: What happens at apply time
ast_claims.quote: 1. **Read.** RTP loads the current on-disk YAML for every file in the prefab's `appliesTo` set. 2. **Merge.** For each file, the prefab's sparse overlay is merged onto the loaded tree. Keys the prefab does not mention are preserved exactly.

ast_claims.src_name: Spatial memory
ast_claims.quote: About 35-65% of typical Minecraft terrain is ocean, lava or void. LeafRTP remembers biomes and invalid chunks (with cause and TTL) at chunk resolution across server restarts so it doesn't check the same dead ground twice.

ast_claims.src_name: Pre-verified cache
ast_claims.quote: Safe destinations are verified in advance and held in background queues. Answering `/rtp` serves an already-checked coordinate without waiting for chunk generation; on Paper the median from command to arrival was 6 ms in the paced…

ast_claims.src_name: Spacing between players
ast_claims.quote: Destinations come from a keyed shuffle of the region, and no player coordinates are tracked. On the default 16,384-block circle, spots drawn back to back sit one bin (512 blocks) apart, and closer where the spiral turns its corners.

helper_bot_cards.title: Why is this running slowly?
helper_bot_cards.quote: These setups work, but they make teleports expensive - either lagging the player who teleports or stalling the whole server. !!!

recommended_changes.reason: Keep chunk loading asynchronous (S-005); synchronous chunk loads stall the main server thread.
Pause background RTP queue pre-generation earlier when server MSPT exceeds 35.0 ms.
Enable adaptive tick-budget pacing for background candidate generation.

helper_bot_cards.title: Background processing and memory
helper_bot_cards.quote: BetterRTP has historically had some difficulty with an attempted queue system, and carries a few extra time costs between command and teleportation.

recommended_changes.reason: Immediately schedule a background refill task whenever a player consumes a cached location.
Run background queue refill checks every 20 ticks (1 second).

helper_bot_cards.title: Compared to other RTP plugins
helper_bot_cards.quote: I took up this project as a challenge to solve a single problem with random teleportation that often gets brushed over - nondeterministic search time due to duplicate selections and the time each selection takes when loading chunks.
